description: Fetch an ingredient-function page from INKEEDecoder (formerly INCIDecoder) — what the function means and which ingredients serve it (for example "emollient"). Accepts a slug, an /ingredient-functions/ path, or an inkeedecoder.com or incidecoder.com URL. Returns one page of ingredients at a time. Read-only.

id.description: Ingredient-function slug (for example "emollient", "antioxidant"), site path (/ingredient-functions/...), or URL on inkeedecoder.com or incidecoder.com.

page.description: 1-based page number. Each response states whether another page is available.

name: inkeedecoder_get_ingredient_function

description.description: What the function means, when the page has an explanation.

ingredients.description: This page of ingredients serving this function.

name.description: Display name as shown on the site.

slug.description: Stable key; pass it back as the `id` of a lookup tool.

nextPageUrl.description: URL of the next page, present when hasMore is true.

title: Get an ingredient function
